title: Waterborne nanoplastics and microplastics: analytical advances, modelling, and future directions
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01084E, Frontier
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zi Wang, Abolghasem Pilechi, Parisa A. Ariya
We analyze advances in analytics, in situ sensing, ML, and fate–transport modelling for decision-ready nano/microplastic measurements. We propose standards, open benchmarks, and uncertainty quantification to deliver policy-relevant indicators.
